# SSE — core-hub: what shingo-core/www/static/app.js does with the shared bus on import
# (its onSSE("system-status") subscription keeps one stream open on every Core page).

a Core page imports app.js
    t=0 open #1 /events?topics=system-status
    #1 listens for: connected, heartbeat, system-status
#1 ← connected {"build":"b1"}
    (nothing)
#1 ← system-status {"fleet":"ok"}
    (nothing)
#1 error
    t=0 close #1
    t=1000 open #2 /events?topics=system-status
    t=1000 lost-connection banner: "Lost connection to Core · last answered 14:00"
    = #2 opened 1000 ms after #1 closed
#2 ← connected {"build":"b2"}  (Core redeployed)
    t=1000 refresh banner shown
    t=1000 lost-connection banner gone
    = "build" banners in the page: 1
    the banner:
      div class="notice-banner notice-banner--info" role="status" data-banner="build"
        span class="notice-text"
          "A new version is available"
        button class="notice-action" type="button" listens=click
          "Refresh"
        button class="notice-dismiss" type="button" aria-label="Dismiss" listens=click
          "×"
#2 ← heartbeat {"build":"b2"} while it is up
    (nothing)
    = "build" banners in the page: 1, the same node
click its Dismiss (×)
    t=1000 refresh banner gone
    = "build" banners in the page: 0
#2 ← heartbeat {"build":"b2"} after Dismiss
    t=1000 refresh banner shown
    = "build" banners in the page: 1
click its Refresh
    t=1000 location.reload()
a page module subscribes onSSE("order-update") after the stream is up
    t=1000 close #2
    t=1000 open #3 /events?topics=order-update%2Csystem-status
3 min on, #3 ← system-status {}, then 4 min of quiet (t=0 is 14:00 UTC, the plant zone)
    (nothing)
    = the last frame at t=181000
#3 error: what the page shows while it is down
    t=421000 close #3
    t=421010 lost-connection banner: "Lost connection to Core · last answered 14:03"
    = elements in the page before the drop 10, 10 ms into it 12
    the lost-connection banner:
      div class="notice-banner notice-banner--warning" role="status" data-banner="connection"
        span class="notice-text"
          "Lost connection to Core · last answered 14:03"
the reconnect opens and fails before any frame, twice
    t=422000 open #4 /events?topics=order-update%2Csystem-status
    t=422000 close #4
    t=424000 open #5 /events?topics=order-update%2Csystem-status
    t=424000 close #5
    = the same node: true; banners in the page: build, connection
the reconnect opens; #6 ← connected {"build":"b2"}
    t=428000 open #6 /events?topics=order-update%2Csystem-status
    t=428000 lost-connection banner gone
